examples.purpose: A category rail on the Invest screen, the guide's In context: a Title over an HStack of four Category Cards, each with an Icon Capsule in imageSlot as its category art, two of them with a badge. active on Gold stands for the category the screen is showing, and each onPress for the screen selecting that card's category (and moving active to it).
examples.jsx:
<VStack>
  <Title title="Invest" subtitle="Pick a category" />
  <HStack>
    <CategoryCard
      label="Gold"
      badge="New"
      imageSlot={<IconCapsule iconName="ic_rupee_coin" />}
      active
      onPress={() => {}}
    />
    <CategoryCard
      label="Loans"
      imageSlot={<IconCapsule iconName="ic_loans" />}
      active={false}
      onPress={() => {}}
    />
    <CategoryCard
      label="Savings"
      imageSlot={<IconCapsule iconName="ic_savings" />}
      active={false}
      onPress={() => {}}
    />
    <CategoryCard
      label="Insurance"
      badge="Hot"
      imageSlot={<IconCapsule iconName="ic_insurance" />}
      active={false}
      onPress={() => {}}
    />
  </HStack>
</VStack>

props.name: label
props.description: Bottom label (e.g. `"Popular"`). Default "Popular", from the component source.

props.name: imageSource
props.description: Image shown in the card centre. Ignored when `imageSlot` / `children` is provided. Accepts a remote URL string, `{ uri }` object, or `require()`-ed asset.

props.name: imageSlot
props.description: Slot replacing the default `Image` (Figma Image instance / Code Connect). Receives `modes` recursively so inner components inherit theming. Prefer this or `children` when swapping the media.

props.name: children
props.description: Alias for {@link imageSlot} — the Figma image slot. When both are set, `imageSlot` wins so existing `imageSlot` callers stay authoritative.

props.name: badge
props.description: An empty string or undefined hides the badge. Declared: Optional badge label rendered as an overlapping pill at the top edge. Omit or pass `undefined` to hide the badge.

props.name: active
props.description: On the web the card also gets aria-pressed from active. Declared: Whether the card is in the selected / active state (gold stroke). When omitted, falls back to `modes['Card Tab State'] === 'Active'` (and the legacy `modes['Category Card State'] === 'Active'` alias).

props.name: width
props.description: Fixed width of the card in dp. Defaults to `60` per the Figma spec. Default 60, from the component source.

props.name: disableTruncation
props.description: disableTruncation={false} alone changes nothing: with singleLine left true, the label still stays on one line and spills. Declared: When `true`, disables text truncation: the trailing ellipsis (`…`) is never shown and any `numberOfLines` clamp is ignored. Defaults to `true` (same overflow behaviour as {@link Text}'s `disableTruncation`). Pass `false` to restore single-line ellipsis clamping. Default true, from the component source.

props.name: singleLine
props.description: When `true`, forces the label onto a single line with no wrapping (implies `disableTruncation`). On web the line overflows horizontally instead of wrapping or truncating. Defaults to `true` — same API as {@link Text}'s `singleLine`. Pass `false` to allow wrapping. Default true, from the component source.

props.name: onPress
props.description: Press handler — the card is always a `Pressable`.

props.name: disabled
props.description: A disabled card renders at 0.5 opacity, with disabled and aria-disabled, tabindex -1 on the web, and no onPress. Declared: Default false, from the component source.

props.name: modes
props.description: Design token modes for theming (e.g. `{ 'Color Mode': 'Light' }`).

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description: The card is always a Pressable with role button, named by accessibilityLabel, or else by the label, with the badge after a comma when there is one (“Gold, New”).

props.name: ...SafePressableProps
props.description: Inherited React Native props the component also accepts. They are not part of the design contract and no guide documents them.

modes.name: AppearanceBrand
modes.description: CategoryCard sets AppearanceBrand Tertiary over the theme's modes, so Tertiary is its default; modes on the card override it. Declared: A token collection CategoryCard reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

modes.name: AppearanceSystem
modes.description: A token collection CategoryCard reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

modes.name: Badge Size
modes.description: CategoryCard sets Badge Size Small over the theme's modes, so Small is its default; modes on the card override it. Declared: A token collection CategoryCard reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

modes.name: Card Tab State
modes.description: The active prop beats the Card Tab State mode: with active set, the card sets Card Tab State from it. Declared: A token collection CategoryCard reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

modes.name: Color Mode
modes.description: A token collection CategoryCard reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

modes.name: Emphasis
modes.description: A token collection CategoryCard reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

modes.name: Radius
modes.description: CategoryCard sets Radius None over the theme's modes, so None (square corners on the default image) is its default; modes on the card override it. Declared: A token collection CategoryCard reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

modes.name: Semantic Intent
modes.description: A token collection CategoryCard reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

slots.description: Slot replacing the default `Image` (Figma Image instance / Code Connect). Receives `modes` recursively so inner components inherit theming. Prefer this or `children` when swapping the media.

slots.description: Alias for {@link imageSlot} — the Figma image slot. When both are set, `imageSlot` wins so existing `imageSlot` callers stay authoritative.

events.description: Press handler — the card is always a `Pressable`.

gaps.text: The label's font token is spelt “Jio Type Var”, so the label shows in a fallback serif font until the token is fixed (token problem #288, open).
Figma ends a long label in an ellipsis; the package lets it spill unless you change singleLine and disableTruncation.
The published Storybook still shows the older generated Category Card page.
